entries.reason: rank 25 of the frameworks demand table, LOAD-FAIL: session's Session and SignalUtilitiesKit strong-import the class, so dyld stops the application before its first line; iOS 6 carries AVPlayerLayer and every UIKit view the controller's own interface is made of
entries.effect: a view controller around a real AVPlayerLayer on the given AVPlayer, with its own controls (play and pause, a scrubber, elapsed and remaining time, Done when presented or in full screen, full screen when inline, picture in picture), contentOverlayView between the video and the controls, videoGravity, readyForDisplay and videoBounds observable, the delegate's picture in picture messages, updatesNowPlayingInfoCenter writing MPNowPlayingInfoCenter, full screen entered and left by entersFullScreenWhenPlaybackBegins and exitsFullScreenWhenPlaybackEnds, and requiresLinearPlayback disabling the scrubber; picture in picture is this package's in-app floating window and does not outlive the application leaving the foreground
entries.source: SDK 16.4, AVKit/AVPlayerViewController.h; the armv7 cache ladder, whose AVKit first carries the class at 8.0 and allowsPictureInPicturePlayback, pixelBufferAttributes and updatesNowPlayingInfoCenter at 9.0

entries.reason: 6.1.3's AVPlayerLayer takes no pixel format, and its AVPlayerItemVideoOutput (6.0) does
entries.effect: kept and copied; while set, an AVPlayerItemVideoOutput made with the attributes (and IOSurface backing, which the release's CoreImage draws from) is on the current item, and its frames are drawn over the player layer with the controller's gravity; a format CoreImage of the release cannot draw leaves the layer's own frames and says so once in the log; nil takes the output away
entries.source: SDK 16.4, AVKit/AVPlayerViewController.h; the armv7 cache ladder, first at 9.0; tests/backports/device/avplayer.m on an iPad 2 running 6.1.3

entries.reason: the delegate of the backports' AVPlayerViewController, which the application adopts
entries.effect: the protocol is the delegate's: an application that adopts it carries its record in its own image, and the controller sends it the picture in picture and full screen messages it implements
entries.source: SDK 16.4, AVKit/AVPlayerViewController.h; the armv7 cache ladder, whose AVKit first carries the controller's delegate at 8.0

entries.reason: the full screen of the backports' AVPlayerViewController is a presentation, and UIKitBackports, which AVKitBackports links, gives every presentation and dismissal a transition coordinator
entries.effect: sent once when the full screen presentation starts, with the CharonTransitionCoordinator of that transition: the delegate can animate alongside it, and its completion runs when the transition ends
entries.source: SDK 16.4, AVKit; tests/backports/device/avplayer.m on an iPad 2 running 6.1.3
